strengths: Addresses important problem of quantifying subjective value alignment with novel methodology combining Bradley-Terry-Davidson and EigenTrust
Black-box approach works with any model, making it practically useful for diverse settings
Comprehensive robustness evaluation including multiple datasets, scenario distributions, model population changes, and adversarial greenbeard attacks
Thorough experimental design with judge quality metrics, variance decomposition, and confidence intervals
Clear practical applications for values-to-leaderboard, character training validation, and disposition comparison
Interesting finding that self-reported survey scores sharply diverge from EigenBench scores, suggesting method captures meaningful signal different from self-assessment
Double-blind evaluation setup and judge scaffold design thoughtfully reduce potential biases
weaknesses: Critical gap: No human validation or correlation with human judgments of alignment—it is unclear whether EigenBench actually measures what practitioners care about
Core assumption that better-aligned models are better judges is unvalidated and could be false if biased models consistently judge through biased lenses
Small intrinsic model variance (21% vs 79% prompt variance) raises questions about how much true model disposition is captured versus prompt effects
Limited model diversity: only 5 frontier models tested; generalization to smaller, older, or specialized models unknown
Constitutional bias concerns: constitutions written with LM assistance; unclear if this introduces subtle biases; no semantic analysis of what latent dimensions represent
Substantial ranking variations across datasets (Table 5) with no principled way to arbitrate which is correct without human reference
Approximately 20% of comparisons remain inconsistent despite collecting both orderings, suggesting persistent order bias
Limited exploration of learned representations: judge lenses and model dispositions not analyzed for interpretability or semantic meaning
Dataset dependence not resolved: empirical results vary meaningfully across scenario distributions without clear guidance on aggregation
